cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Mr. and Mrs. George Hopper Fitch, New York, NY, 1961 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Whitney Mus. May 1946. . . . Probably ptd. 1915 or 1916." Downtown Gallery Archive dates c. 1920. Abiquiú Notebooks records, "Dated [1918] by O'Keeffe May, 1957." One of a series O'Keeffe completed at Lake George 1918/1920, see cat. nos. 269, 271–74. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: backing inscription, Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Red Canna

description: Vibrant red canna flowers with thick, curved petals occupy the center of the composition. Light gray, purple, and green leaves frame the flowers, which are supported by a broad green stem. The bright flora stands out against a plain white background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
